summary: VersaBank (TSX:VBNK; NASDAQ:VBNK) filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated May 26, 2026, announcing its second quarter fiscal 2026 financial results conference call/webcast scheduled for June 3, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. ET. The call will feature President David Taylor and Global CFO Nicolas Ospina. This is a routine earnings announcement and conference call notice, with no special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. As a foreign private issuer filing under the Exchange Act, the filing is procedural and not deemed filed for Section 18 purposes.
